hero.subtitle: A space where aesthetic medicine, nutrition and healthy habits work together — so feeling well shows in the way you look.

philosophy.heading: It’s not only about looking well.
philosophy.rest: feeling well — and keeping it over time.
philosophy.body: We work one-on-one, listening and tailoring each treatment to what each person really needs. No unrealistic expectations. With judgement, empathy and a complete view of wellbeing.

pillars.p1Body: Every decision takes your story, skin and goals into account — not passing trends.
pillars.p2Body: Aesthetic medicine + nutrition + habits. Results last when everything aligns.
pillars.p3Body: Safe interventions that enhance without erasing what makes you you.

treatments.heading: Tailored facial
treatments.subheading: Each plan is designed during the initial consultation, based on a full diagnosis.

limpieza.name: Deep facial cleanse
limpieza.short: Removes impurities, dead cells and excess sebum to unclog pores.
limpieza.long: Deep facial cleanse that removes impurities, dead cells and excess sebum, freeing pores and improving skin texture. Includes cleansing, exfoliation, extractions and specific actives, leaving skin cleaner, more luminous and balanced.

limpieza-alquimia.name: Deep facial cleanse with Alquimia
limpieza-alquimia.short: Comprehensive device-assisted ritual that cleanses, hydrates and improves luminosity and firmness.
limpieza-alquimia.long: Integral, deep and complete treatment that cleanses, hydrates and improves the luminosity and firmness of the skin. Finished with facial massage for extra relaxation. Includes face, neck, décolletage, lips and eyelids.

peeling.name: Peeling
peeling.short: Controlled cellular renewal adapted to the required depth.
peeling.long: Acid application that accelerates cell turnover, treating spots, uneven texture, enlarged pores and signs of ageing. The variant is chosen based on the required depth:
bullets: Cosmetic (mild) — superficial renewal, no visible peeling · $65.000
Medical (medium) — deeper layers, improves spots, pores and fine lines · $80.000
Medical (strong) — intensive renewal for pronounced spots, acne or ageing · $80.000

radiofrecuencia.name: Fractional Radiofrequency
radiofrecuencia.short: Stimulates collagen and elastin for a progressive tightening effect with minimal recovery.
radiofrecuencia.long: Fractional radiofrequency stimulates collagen and elastin production through micro-energy in the deep skin layers. Improves firmness, texture and wrinkles, achieving a progressive tightening effect with minimal recovery.

fraxface.name: FraxFace
fraxface.short: Rejuvenation with fractional technology to improve texture, pores and firmness.
fraxface.long: Rejuvenation treatment combining fractional technology to stimulate deep collagen production. Improves firmness, texture, pores and fine lines, achieving smoother, more even and luminous skin with progressive recovery.

fraxface-prp.name: FraxFace with Platelet-Rich Plasma
fraxface-prp.short: Fractional technology combined with platelet-rich plasma for enhanced results and faster recovery.
fraxface-prp.long: Rejuvenation treatment combining fractional technology with plasma rich in regenerative actives. Stimulates collagen production, improves skin texture, firmness and luminosity, enhancing results and promoting faster recovery.

hifu-facial.name: HIFU 25D Max with Liposonix
hifu-facial.short: Non-invasive facial lift with focused ultrasound to tighten and redefine contour.
hifu-facial.long: Non-invasive treatment using focused ultrasound to tighten skin and reduce localised fat. Improves firmness, redefines contour and generates a progressive lifting effect.
bullets: Full face with double chin · $88.000 · 1 hr
Full face with neck and double chin · $99.000 · 1 hr
Full face, double chin and décolletage · $110.000 · 1 hr 30 min

prp.name: Platelet-Rich Plasma
prp.short: Regenerative treatment with your own growth factors to improve texture and firmness.
prp.long: Platelet-rich plasma (PRP) is a regenerative treatment that stimulates collagen and cellular repair using your own growth factors. Improves skin texture, luminosity and firmness. Maximum 4 sessions per year.

meso-facial.name: Facial mesotherapy
meso-facial.short: Vitamin and antioxidant micro-injections to hydrate, brighten and stimulate collagen.
meso-facial.long: Superficial micro-injections into the dermis with actives such as vitamins, minerals and antioxidants. Deep hydration and improved skin quality, increased luminosity, collagen and elastin stimulation, and softening of fine lines. Fast, minimally invasive procedure.

meso-ojeras.name: Under-eye mesotherapy
meso-ojeras.short: Micro-injections with depigmenting and hydrating actives for the periocular area.
meso-ojeras.long: Superficial micro-injections in the periocular area with depigmenting, hydrating and antioxidant actives. Helps brighten under-eye pigmentation, improves skin hydration and quality, illuminates the gaze and softens fine lines. Fast, minimally invasive procedure.

skinbooster.name: Skinbooster
skinbooster.short: Low-density hyaluronic acid for deep, sustained hydration and improved skin quality.
skinbooster.long: Micro-injections of low-density hyaluronic acid into the dermis to deeply hydrate and improve skin quality. Provides deep and sustained hydration, improves texture and elasticity, adds luminosity and softens fine lines.

botox.name: Botox (botulinum toxin)
botox.short: Botulinum toxin micro-injections to relax muscles and soften expression lines.
botox.long: Application of botulinum toxin micro-injections to specific muscles to relax their contraction. Areas: upper third (forehead, glabella and crow’s feet), bruxism (masseters), nasal tip, gummy smile and lip corners. Visible effect at 5–7 days, touch-ups at 10–15 days. Duration: 4 to 5 months depending on the patient.

relleno.name: Hyaluronic acid filler
relleno.short: Restores volume and defines contours for a natural, immediate result.
relleno.long: Micro-injections of hyaluronic acid to restore volume, define contours and improve facial harmony. Areas: lips (volume, definition and hydration), cheekbones (nasolabial fold or marionette lines), chin, jawline and under-eye. We do not perform rhinomodelling. Result duration: 6 to 8 months depending on product density and each patient.

radiesse.name: Biostimulators (Radiesse)
radiesse.short: Calcium hydroxylapatite biostimulator that activates natural collagen and elastin production.
radiesse.long: Not a filler. Calcium hydroxylapatite biostimulator that activates the production of your own collagen and elastin. Improves firmness and elasticity, restructures and defines contours with natural, long-lasting results. Progressive effect: visible from 2 months, lasting approximately 1 year.

prp-capilar.name: Hair Platelet-Rich Plasma
prp-capilar.short: Growth-factor-rich plasma to stimulate follicles and improve hair density.
prp-capilar.long: Platelet-rich plasma obtained from the patient’s blood is applied to the scalp. Growth factors stimulate hair follicles and improve blood supply. Reduces hair loss, stimulates growth, improves thickness and density, strengthens the follicle and adds shine and quality to hair.

meso-capilar.name: Hair mesotherapy
meso-capilar.short: Nourishing micro-injections to activate the follicle and improve scalp health.
meso-capilar.long: Micro-injections into the scalp with actives such as vitamins, minerals, amino acids and stimulating factors to nourish and activate the hair follicle. Reduces shedding, stimulates growth, improves thickness and density, strengthens hair and improves scalp quality.

criolipolisis.name: Cryolipolysis
criolipolisis.short: Controlled cold to destroy fat cells and reshape body contour, non-surgically.
criolipolisis.long: Application of controlled cold to the target area to trigger the destruction of adipocyte cells. Reduces localised fat and shapes body contour. Non-invasive procedure with progressive, natural results. May cause temporary redness or sensitivity.

body-up.name: Body Up
body-up.short: Electromagnetic muscle stimulation to tone and define body contour.
body-up.long: Non-invasive treatment using electromagnetic muscle stimulation to generate intense contractions, working the muscle in depth. Tones and strengthens musculature, improves body firmness, helps reduce localised fat and defines contour.

peptonas.name: Peptonas
peptonas.short: Deep muscle stimulation to reduce fat and improve body contour.
peptonas.long: Non-invasive treatment using electromagnetic muscle stimulation to generate intense contractions, working the muscle in depth. Tones and strengthens musculature, improves body firmness, helps reduce localised fat and defines contour.

meso-celulitis.name: Cellulite mesotherapy
meso-celulitis.short: Lipolytic and draining micro-injections to improve cellulite-affected tissue.
meso-celulitis.long: Superficial micro-injections in the target area with lipolytic, draining and firming actives to improve the tissue. Improves the appearance of cellulite, reduces fluid retention, improves skin texture and adds firmness.

enzimas-lipoliticas.name: Lipolytic enzymes
enzimas-lipoliticas.short: Phosphatidylcholine micro-injections to break down localised fat with progressive results.
enzimas-lipoliticas.long: Micro-injections in the target area with phosphatidylcholine to promote the breakdown of localised fat. Reduces localised adiposity, improves body contour, complements other reduction treatments. Progressive results.

hifu-corporal.name: HIFU 25D 360 — body
hifu-corporal.short: High-intensity focused ultrasound to reduce fat and improve body firmness.
hifu-corporal.long: High-intensity focused ultrasound technology acting in depth to destroy fat cells and enhance the reduction of localised adiposity. Reduces fat, improves skin firmness, defines body contour and stimulates collagen. No recovery time.

depilacion.name: Laser hair removal
depilacion.short: Soprano Ice Titanium laser for progressive, long-lasting hair reduction.
depilacion.long: Treatment with Soprano Ice Titanium laser technology that acts on the hair follicle through heat, progressively weakening hair growth without damaging the skin. Progressive and lasting reduction, suitable for different skin types and body areas. Fast, virtually painless, with a cooling system for greater comfort.

consulta-medica.name: Medical aesthetic consultation
consulta-medica.short: Personalised diagnosis and comprehensive aesthetic treatment plan.
consulta-medica.long: Consultation with an aesthetic medicine specialist for personalised diagnosis and definition of an integral treatment plan. The starting point for any treatment.

nutricion.name: Nutrition consultation
nutricion.short: Nutritional consultation and personalised eating plan to sustain results.
nutricion.long: Nutritional support to complement the aesthetic journey. Personalised eating plan with sustainable habits so results hold over time.

about.heading: Two sisters,
about.intro: D’Ursi Estética was born from a very personal place: the idea of approaching beauty in a real, mindful, integral way. We are Estefanía and Vanina — each with her own path, sharing the same view of wellbeing.
about.vaninaBio: Medical doctor specialised in aesthetic medicine.
about.vaninaBioDetail: I’ve worked in the field since I was 18 — first in dermatocosmetics and cosmetic chemistry, then across aesthetic and dermatology centres. I deepened my training with postgraduate programs and a master’s degree in facial harmonisation — always focused on natural, safe results.
about.vaninaOff: Off-hours: pilates, books, constant learning, travel and mate.
about.estefaniaBioDetail: For years I was a patient and walked through several centres — that experience shaped how I wanted to work: with empathy, judgement and a complete view. I accompany the process from habits and nutrition so aesthetic results hold over time.
about.estefaniaOff: Off-hours: drawing, painting, friends, family, travel and a good table.

space.heading: Paternal,
space.body: An intimate practice, designed so each consultation is personalised and unhurried. By appointment only — this way every treatment gets the time it deserves.
